rule_evidence.evidence_text: TRAINING-LINE does not accept IMDG Class 1 on the teaching route.
TRAINING-LINE does not accept IMDG Class 7 on the teaching route.
TRAINING-LINE does not accept Class 3 cargo below -18°C flash point.
TRAINING-LINE does not accept dangerous goods in reefer equipment on the teaching route.
IBC packaging requires case-by-case approval from the teaching DG Desk.

documents.title: Booking Precheck Documentation and Consistency Standard

rule_evidence.evidence_text: Dangerous-goods bookings must provide a preliminary DGD.
Dangerous-goods bookings must provide an SDS Extract.
The preliminary DGD must contain a valid UN Number.
The preliminary DGD must contain a Proper Shipping Name.
The SDS Extract must contain transport information in Section 14.
The SDS Extract must not be older than 24 months at submission.
The Booking Request must identify a consignee.
Booking Request and preliminary DGD UN Numbers must match.
preliminary DGD and SDS Extract UN Numbers must match.
preliminary DGD and SDS Extract IMDG classes must match.
Booking and preliminary DGD gross-weight variance must not exceed 2 percent.
Booking and preliminary DGD package counts must match.
preliminary DGD and SDS Extract marine-pollutant declarations must match.
Class 3 cargo must have a usable flash point in SDS Extract Section 9.
The teaching snapshot only covers CNSHA to AEJEA on TRAIN-ME1.
A partner-operated vessel requires manual route approval.
Documents must be submitted at least five working days before ETD.
preliminary DGD and SDS Extract Packing Groups must match.
The preliminary DGD shipper declaration must be signed.
A key extracted field below 0.80 confidence requires confirmation.
A booking with ETD after snapshot expiry requires a current policy snapshot.
Conflicting actions from equal-priority applicable rules require policy-owner review.
AEJEA-TRAIN-T1 temporarily suspends dangerous-goods acceptance from 2026-09-10 through 2026-09-12.
